description: This PHP class defines the ProjectActivity entity for the OrangeHRM Time Plugin. It models a project activity with properties such as id, associated project, deletion status, name, and related timesheet items. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ProjectActivity
classes.description: Entity class representing a project activity within the OrangeHRM system, mapped to the database table 'ohrm_project_activity'. It includes properties for id, project reference, deletion flag, name, and related timesheet items, along with standard getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the project activity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the project activity.

methods.name: setProject
methods.description: Associates this activity with a Project entity.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Returns whether the activity is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Sets the deletion status of the activity.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the activity.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the activity.
